title.zh: 将苏丹库达拉特省Kalamansig市镇Kalamansig市镇医院由10张床位的市镇医院扩建升级为25张床位的区医院，名称为Kalamansig区医院，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Expanding and Upgrading the Kalamanslg Municipal Hospital in the Municipality of Kalamansig, Province of Sultan Kudarat, From A Ten-bed Capacity Municipal Hospital Into A Twenty-five-bed Capacity District Hospital, To Be Known As Kalamansig District Hospital, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

text.en: The Kalamansig Municipal Hospital in the Municipality of Kalamansig, Province of Sultan Kudarat, is hereby expanded and upgraded from a ten-bed capacity municipal hospital into a twenty-five-bed capacity district hospital, to be known as the Kalamansig District Hospital.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
